validity.researcher_notes: The row's ONLY cited source for every field (Status, Fuel, PipelineType, Proposal date, Capacity, Pressure, Length, Diameter, SegmentCost) is a single in-en.com URL: https://gas.in-en.com/html/gas-2751746.shtml. Direct fetch returns HTTP 403 from multiple UAs/IPs, but that is NOT a bot-block: bypassing the WAF via r.jina.ai and via Google Translate's proxy (gas-in--en-com.translate.goog) both returned the site's own native 404 page ('哎呀，出错了！您访问的页面不存在......或已被删除！' / 'the page you visited does not exist... or has been deleted'). So the citation is confirmed DEAD at the source, not merely blocked. Wayback Machine (availability API) has no snapshot for this URL either -- it was never archived. I then searched extensively (DuckDuckGo, Bing, Baidu -- Baidu captcha-blocked) for any independent trace of a 'Xincheng' (新城) gas branch pipeline in Laibin, Guangxi, in both English and Chinese, including site-restricted searches on fgw.gxzf.gov.cn (Guangxi NDRC approvals) and combinations with the stated operator 'Guangxi Guangtou Natural Gas Pipe Network Co Ltd' (广西广投天然气管网有限公司) and the 2017-12 proposal date. Every hit that surfaced was for OTHER, clearly distinct Laibin-area gas projects: the much larger 'Laibin natural gas branch pipeline (Xingbin-Wuxuan / Wuxuan-Xiangzhou-Jinxiu section)' (total investment RMB196.9M, multi-county, 2022-2025 approvals), the Qianjiang (迁江) industrial-park supply branch (~16.5km), and a 2015-era 'Laibin natural gas dedicated-supply pipeline' (7.77km, RMB55.22M, in-en.com article ID 2644481 -- confirmed live and unrelated). None of these name 'Xincheng' or match this row's specific figures (29km / 0.04 bcm/y / 273mm / RMB107,250,000 / proposed 2017-12). Roster cross-check: no other P#### in the 43-row set carries a 'Xincheng' location or matching specs, so this doesn't look like an internal duplicate/relabel -- it looks like an entity whose sole citation is a now-dead, unarchived, and independently untraceable news item. Given standing rule 1 (existence is job #1) and the sweep instructions ('if the sheet's cited source does not actually name this pipeline, or you cannot find independent confirmation, flag existence'), I am flagging this row rather than confirming it. I cannot rule out that the article once existed and was legitimate (in-en.com/gas.in-en.com is a real trade-press outlet and other article IDs near this one are genuine), but as it stands there is zero verifiable support for any field on this row.
